sentence: This project uses a trapped-ion quantum apparatus to study how complex physical systems, such as quantum materials and chemistry, behave.
This project tries to find out how climate changes affect plant species directly and through their interactions with other species.
This project develops safe reinforcement learning methods for home robots, using logical specifications grounded in visual perception.
This project develops wireless communication and artificial intelligence tools to infer which bird, insect and bat species are present, based on their vocalizations.
This project studies why ultrathin semiconductors and quantum materials degrade in air, and how organic chemicals on their surfaces can protect them.
This project develops a machine-learning based emulator that links the description of neutron star matter to the astrophysical observables it provides.
This project studies how neurons in the early visual cortex quickly form local recurrent circuits that encode relationships between concepts.
This project develops a robotics program built on socio-emotional learning for confined youth in a juvenile justice alternative education program.
This project studies the protein-protein interactions of a computationally designed protein that modulates gene expression in an ovarian cancer cell line.
This project creates a knowledge graph that connects data, climate models and tasks, using deep learning to find them in research papers.
This project explores the properties of two-dimensional quantum materials, including topological superconductivity, for use in future quantum computers.
This project studies how modifications of mRNA help sorghum respond to drought and heat stress.
This project studies how trees and soil water together control the movement of water through forests on plateaus and valleys in the Amazon.
This project uses artificial intelligence, computer modeling and experiments to find out how liquid flow inside porous materials helps deliver genetic material into cells.
This project develops artificial intelligence agents that continuously evaluate and enforce authorization policies protecting sensitive data and resources.
This project studies how human land use change affects caddisflies, a group of aquatic insects, in streams across three continents.
